messages.body_plain:
I will present an invited address for the American Sociological Association Methodology section on August 13 at 2:30-3:30, Philadelphia PA. http://www.asanet.org/annual-meeting-2018.

Title will be “Quantifying What it Would Take to Change an Inference: Toward a Pragmatic Sociology.”  Perhaps see you there.

I will present a short course on causal inference and sensitivity analysis at Peking University July 23-August 3

Qinyun Lin will present sensitivity for value added models using case replacement at a conference sponsored by Beijing Normal University at 8am on July 21 in Beijing.

ken
